request: Add the add_victorops view in hc/front/views.py so logged-in users can save a VictorOps webhook URL to their project.

summary.result_text:
I added the `add` view, but in `hc/integrations/victorops/views.py` rather than `hc/front/views.py`. I haven't run the tests: the test command was blocked pending approval.

`hc/integrations/victorops/urls.py` already routes `add_victorops/` to `views.add` in that file, and the file had only imports and no function. Putting it in `hc/front/views.py` would have left the URL conf unchanged and pointing at nothing.

The view follows the same pattern as the Opsgenie one:
- It requires `VICTOROPS_ENABLED`, so it returns 404 when the integration is disabled.
- It requires login and read-write access to the project, so read-only members get 403.
- It validates the submitted URL with `forms.AddUrlForm`, so a bad URL re-renders the form with an error.
- On a valid POST it saves a `victorops` channel with the URL as its value, assigns all the project's checks to it, and redirects to the channels page.
- It renders the existing `add_victorops.html` template.

To check it, run `python manage.py test hc.integrations.victorops`. That runs the existing `test_add.py` and `test_notify.py` for this integration.
